## Carousel

- Changing game now works like the Apple TV app: as you swipe, the picture follows your finger across the whole slide, sliding away and fading while the next game's picture, already partly there underneath, comes in from the side. The logo and buttons fade out as you start and the next game's fade in at the end. Let go before a quarter of the way and it goes back.
- The same change, animated, is used when a trailer ends, when you tap the dots or use the controller. Past the last game it wraps round to the first.
